title: Carolina Beach Pontoon Rental

services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Hop aboard a pontoon with one of our captains for an awesome evening with family and friends to experience the sunset on the Intracoastal Waterway and/or Carolina Beach’s Fireworks By The Sea from afar. Sunset cruises are offered Monday-Thursday. Firework Cruise is offered on Thursdays (Memorial Day-Labor Day)
